headline: Enhancing ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: By integrating public trend signals, ClearInstall can better identify and mitigate risks associated with npm/PyPI packages. This will improve the security and reliability of local-first installations.
actions: Integrate real-time package vulnerability alerts from services like Snyk or Node Security Project to warn users about potential risks before installation.
